name: Cessna 172S — conventional panel
description: 1998-issued POH, Revision 5 (2004). IO-360-L2A, fuel injection, conventional instruments; not a G1000 or earlier 172 variant.

aircraft.scope: Reference serials 172S8001 and on; conventional-panel basic handbook. Installed avionics and supplements may differ.

name: Cessna 150M — 1976 model
description: 1976 Model 150M POH. Continental O-200-A, carburetor, fixed-pitch propeller; standard and optional long-range fuel distinguished.

aircraft.scope: Reference serials 15077380 and on. Not the Cessna 152; actual modifications and installed tanks must be checked.

name: Piper Archer II — PA-28-181
description: VB-1120 handbook, originally issued July 1979. Carbureted Archer II with manual flaps; excludes appended aircraft-specific STCs.

aircraft.edition: POH/AFM VB-1120 · July 1979 issue, mixed revised pages
aircraft.scope: Basic handbook only; applicability is aircraft-specific. Not an Archer III/TX or a blanket reference for later engine/avionics modifications.

name: King Air 200 / 200C — PT6A-41
description: POH/AFM 101-590010-127, Revision A13 (January 2002). Original 200-series PT6A-41 systems; not a B200, 250, 260, or 350.

aircraft.scope: Only serials listed on the handbook title page, with the described PT6A-41 configuration. Later models, modifications, and supplements are excluded.
